title: Fair Candy Swap
description: Find a pair of candies to swap so that both Alice and Bob have the same total candy amount.
pseudocode:
1. sumA = sum(aliceSizes)
2. sumB = sum(bobSizes)
3. diff = (sumA - sumB) / 2
4. setB = new Set(bobSizes)
5. for x in aliceSizes:
6.   target = x - diff
7.   if setB.has(target):
8.     return [x, target]

steps.note: Store Bob's candies in a Set for O(1) lookup
